title: Подсчёт активностей по статусам через SQL-скрипт
task: Посчитай по базе, сколько активностей (Activity) в каждом статусе, и заполни в справочнике статусов активностей колонку «Описание» текстом вида «Записей: N» — через SQL-скрипт пакета с именем {{prefix}}EvalStatusDescription.
setupSql: DO $$ BEGIN CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "{{prefix}}EvalStatusBackup" AS SELECT "Id", "Description" FROM "ActivityStatus"; IF to_regclass('public."SysActivityStatusLcz"') IS NOT NULL THEN CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "{{prefix}}EvalStatusLczBackup" AS SELECT "Id", "Description" FROM "SysActivityStatusLcz"; END IF; END $$;
teardownSql: DO $$ BEGIN IF to_regclass('public."{{prefix}}EvalStatusBackup"') IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE "ActivityStatus" s SET "Description" = b."Description" FROM "{{prefix}}EvalStatusBackup" b WHERE s."Id" = b."Id"; DROP TABLE "{{prefix}}EvalStatusBackup"; END IF; IF to_regclass('public."{{prefix}}EvalStatusLczBackup"') IS NOT NULL THEN UPDATE "SysActivityStatusLcz" s SET "Description" = b."Description" FROM "{{prefix}}EvalStatusLczBackup" b WHERE s."Id" = b."Id"; DELETE FROM "SysActivityStatusLcz" WHERE "Id" NOT IN (SELECT "Id" FROM "{{prefix}}EvalStatusLczBackup"); DROP TABLE "{{prefix}}EvalStatusLczBackup"; END IF; END $$;

checks.sql: SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "ActivityStatus" WHERE "Description" ~ '^(Записей|Records): [0-9]+') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SysActivityStatusLcz" WHERE "Description" ~ '^(Записей|Records): [0-9]+')
